description: This file defines the Request class in the Slim Framework, implementing the ServerRequestInterface from PSR-7. It manages HTTP request details such as method, URI, headers, cookies, server parameters, parsed body, uploaded files, and request attributes.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, implementing server request interface, handling request details and cloning behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object with method, URI, headers, cookies, server parameters, body, and uploaded files; sets default protocol and host header.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs deep-copy of headers and body upon cloning.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Creates a clone with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: filterMethod
methods.description: Validates and filters the HTTP method string.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, constructing it from URI if not explicitly set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a clone with a specific request target string.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a clone with a new URI, optionally preserving the host header.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Returns cookies parameters.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a clone with specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns the query parameters, parsing from URI if necessary.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a clone with specified query parameters.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns uploaded files collection.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a clone with the specified uploaded files collection.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns server environment variables.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns request attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute value, or default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a clone with a new attribute.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a clone without a specified attribute.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body of the request.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a clone with new parsed body data, validating input.
